run_GAN_training: run the BigGAN training loop with a config dict using slurm or local DDP setup
run_DDP_training: run distributed BigGAN training across multiple GPUs using torch multiprocessing spawn
train_GAN_model: train a BigGAN generator and discriminator with optional EMA, FP16, and class conditioning
train_with_early_stopping: train the GAN model with early stopping based on FID patience and divergence detection
run_single_gpu_training: run single GPU BigGAN training by setting ddp_train to false in the config
